usedFor: Shopify is the store and RD Station is the marketing automation side. An “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify can feed “Create or Update Contact” in RD Station, so people who stopped at checkout end up as tagged contacts you can market to.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Create or Update Contact” in RD Station
bestTemplate.why: The abandoned checkout carries an email or phone, which is what RD Station matches on. “Create or Update Contact” sets name, phone and tags, so it doesn't duplicate a returning shopper.

watchOut: “Create or Update Contact” works from the email, so a checkout with only a phone number has nothing to match. “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so it runs on a schedule.
